metadata.description: Self-hosted copilot skills for Claude Code: home infrastructure, retro gaming, career, health and civic chores. Lean on tokens, private by construction.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Setup, health checks and safe publishing: doctor, new-machine bootstrap, and a leak-guarded ship-public flow.

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Keep a Linux home machine healthy: daily health check with notifications (updates, disks, SMART, mounts, services, containers, tailnet) and guided system updates, and an Android TV kept current over adb (Stremio, SmartTube, Tailscale, Key Mapper remote remaps), and a debloated, unattended Windows 11 install USB.

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Unattended weekday job digest: job feeds and boards, recruiter-mail triage, reply and outreach drafts (never sent), LinkedIn alert and notification cleanup, one ranked digest by email.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Emulation library care: audit, CHD/RVZ conversion, multi-disc playlists, 50 Hz detection, and device sync over adb or to SD cards; PC games into Steam and Apollo/Sunshine with art; PC graphics settings tuned per game (FSR 4, frame gen, OptiScaler) with a daily pass.

plugins.name: health
plugins.description: Daily health coach: ring/Apple Health data in, a tiny gamified plan out (exercise snacks, seasonal recipe, sleep) by email each morning; check-ins by replying, XP and trends.

plugins.name: civic
plugins.description: Подай глобата (podai-globata): 1+ photos of a wrongly parked car in Bulgaria become a formal СВЕДЕНИЕ to the МВР reception, with the municipality in copy (time, address, plate, legal basis) - as a Gmail draft, mailto link or copy text.
